title: Run 161 re-measures the maintained packaged-regression gate unmodified on the unchanged candidate and identifies the single root cause the earlier runs missed: the artifact completes all four smoke phases and writes COMPLETE PASSING runtime evidence, then fails to exit before the gate's hardcoded timeout=25, and the gate discards the passing evidence and reports 1/20

candidate_under_test.reverified_by: Get-FileHash SHA256 + byte length + recursive file count, read-only

harness_under_test.note: Unmodified in this dispatch; byte-identical before and after; untouched since 2026-09-22, i.e. never touched by W57.

measurement_A_maintained_entrypoint_unmo.details_each_run: workdir_outside_repo=true, timeout='artifact did not exit within 25s', child_killed=true, exit_code=null

measurement_B_the_evidence_the_gate_thre.purpose: read the packaged runtime sidecar that the harness never opens on the timed_out branch; this is the same file the gate would have scored
measurement_B_the_evidence_the_gate_thre.why_the_two_artifact_failures_are_not_pr: Both are recomputed and overridden by the gate itself and are not read from the artifact. pty_resize is skipped in the artifact-check loop at wx_packaged_smoke.py:206 and recomputed from the disposable loopback server at wx_packaged_smoke.py:210-220; clean_shutdown is recomputed at wx_packaged_smoke.py:236 from returncode/isolation/runtime result. So every check the artifact can actually prove passed.

write_timing_run1.interpretation: The gate's timeout fires at 25 s and the child is killed and reaped before the verdict is written, so the artifact had already finished its work and written complete PASS evidence roughly 5-7 s into the run, then did not exit for the remaining ~18 s.

root_cause.statement: The packaged artifact completes every smoke phase, writes a complete PASS runtime payload, and then does not terminate before the gate's hardcoded timeout=25. scripts/wx_packaged_smoke.py:190-192 short-circuits on timed_out, sets details.timeout/child_killed, and never opens the runtime evidence file, so all 19 remaining checks keep their initial FAIL and the gate reports 1/20 for a working artifact.
code_path: scripts/wx_packaged_smoke.py:128 - def run_packaged_smoke(..., timeout: int = 25) - the hardcoded budget
scripts/wx_packaged_smoke.py:190-192 - if timed_out: details['timeout']=...; details['child_killed']=True  # runtime evidence never read
scripts/wx_packaged_smoke.py:196 - runtime = json.loads(runtime_output.read_text(...))  # unreachable on the timed_out branch
root_cause.budget_is_not_internally_consistent: In the same maintained file, run_fresh_user_smoke uses timeout=240 by default (wx_packaged_smoke.py:346) for a comparable packaged GUI workload with two launches, while run_packaged_smoke uses timeout=25 (wx_packaged_smoke.py:128) for a heavier 20-check workload against a real loopback paramiko SSH/SFTP fixture and a wx+WebView2 child. The 25 s constant is therefore not a validated figure.
root_cause.25s_is_provably_not_intrinsically_insuff: artifacts/wave_W57/W57_PACKAGED_SMOKE_8BA80453_PASS.json (2026-09-28 01:06) is PASS 20/20 with exit_code 0 on the identical artifact SHA-256 through the same unmodified harness, so the artifact can finish and exit inside 25 s. What varies is the latency of its post-phase-4 shutdown, not its work.
